notes: A "package" was the value of package: on a class definition - a string. No requires, no load order, no uninstall, and nothing checking what depended on what. It is why the Package Dependencies Browser was deliberately not built. - THE BASELINE IS A CLASS, NOT A FILE. BaselineOf<Package> with class-side packageName / requires / description, living IN the package it describes - so it travels through the Tonel projection, the .otspkg artifact, the quarantine, XMPP and git with NO change to any of them. Proven by serializing a package and finding its baseline inside the payload. - MEMBERSHIP IS DE
